a1.say: Let's build Your First REST Endpoint.

a1.cap: Create a GET /api/hello endpoint that takes an optional name query parameter (default "world") and returns JSON like {"message": "Hello, Ada!"}. Use a Java record for the response body.

lines: Create a GET /api/hello endpoint that takes an optional name query parameter (default "world") and returns JSON like {"message": "Hello, Ada!"}. Use a Java record for the response body.

a1.cap: A @RestController class handles web requests and returns objects that Spring turns into JSON. @GetMapping maps a URL path to a method, and @RequestParam reads a query parameter.
a1.say: A at Rest Controller class handles web requests and returns objects that Spring turns into JSON. at Get Mapping maps a URL path to a method, and at Request Param reads a query parameter.

a1.cap: Returning a small immutable record keeps the response shape explicit and type-safe.
@RestController marks this class as a web controller whose return values become the response body, as JSON.
a1.say: at Rest Controller marks this class as a web controller whose return values become the response body, as JSON.

a1.cap: @RequestMapping on the class gives every endpoint inside a common /api prefix.
a1.say: at Request Mapping on the class gives every endpoint inside a common /api prefix.

a1.cap: A record is a compact immutable data class. Jackson serialises its message field automatically.
@GetMapping maps HTTP GET requests for /api/hello to this method.

a1.cap: @RequestParam reads the name query parameter, falling back to world when it's missing.
